name: Central Montana Food Hub
old_description: Central Montana Food Hub is your source for high quality local food. Ordering from Central Montana Food Hub helps to build and support our local producers, and to preserve our precious agricultural land for sustainable future use.
about:
Central Montana Food Hub operates from Martinsdale, Montana, as an aggregator and online marketplace for locally grown and produced food. The company connects regional producers with consumers, restaurants, institutions, and retailers across a wide swath of central Montana.

The hub manages an online ordering platform that opens weekly for home delivery and community pickup in towns including Livingston, Big Timber, White Sulphur Springs, Harlowton, and Lewistown. It handles meat, produce, eggs, honey, grains, and other products, providing packaging and delivery logistics for its producer network. Wholesale customers receive customized ordering with recurring options.

The service supplies dining establishments such as Wild Oats Bakery, Jesse Peppers Smoke Shack, The Mint Bar, Musselshell Steakhouse, and Gally’s Brewing Co., as well as grocery stores like Lewistown Town and County, Midtown Market 2, and Castle Mountain Grocery. It also participates in the Harlo Farmers Market and White Sulphur Springs Farmers Market.

The organization states its purpose is to build and support local producers and preserve agricultural land for sustainable use, simplifying the process for farmers to meet demand for local food.
